content.content:
I'm looking to book a hotel in Paris for May 1st to May 5th.
            Can you suggest a hotel that's under 210? If there are a few choices, go for the one with the highest rating.
            Please give me the hotel's name, rating, price range. Also, can you add an event called "Booking hotel {hotel_name}" to my calendar on April 25th 2024, and set the location to the hotel's address? Just to remind me to book ahead of time. Thanks!

Hotel Names: Le Marais Boutique
Good Night
Luxury Palace
Montmartre Suites

```python
from pydantic import BaseModel

# Step 1: Get all hotels in Paris
hotels_str = get_all_hotels_in_city("Paris")
class HotelList(BaseModel):
    hotels: list[str]
hotels = query_ai_assistant(
    "Extract a list of hotel names from the following string.",
    HotelList
).model_validate({"hotels": hotels_str}).hotels

# Step 2: Get prices for all hotels
prices = get_hotels_prices(hotels)

# Step 3: Filter hotels under 210
class HotelPrice(BaseModel):
    name: str
    price: float
hotels_under_210 = [
    HotelPrice.model_validate({"name": name, "price": float(prices[name])})
    for name in prices.keys()
    if float(prices[name]) < 210
]
if len(hotels_under_210) == 0:
    raise ValueError("No hotels found under 210 in Paris for the given dates.")

# Step 4: Get ratings for filtered hotels
hotel_names_under_210 = [h.name for h in hotels_under_210]
ratings = get_rating_reviews_for_hotels(hotel_names_under_210)

# Step 5: Find the hotel with the highest rating
class HotelRating(BaseModel):
    name: str
    rating: float
hotel_ratings = []
for name in ratings.keys():
    # Parse the rating from the review string
    class RatingOnly(BaseModel):
        rating: float
    rating = query_ai_assistant(
        f"Extract only the numerical rating (as float) from this review string: {ratings[name]}",
        RatingOnly
    ).rating
    hotel_ratings = [*hotel_ratings, HotelRating.model_validate({"name": name, "rating": rating})]

# Find the hotel with the highest rating
best_hotel = sorted(hotel_ratings, key=lambda x: x.rating, reverse=True)[0]
best_hotel_name = best_hotel.name
best_hotel_rating = best_hotel.rating
best_hotel_price = [h.price for h in hotels_under_210 if h.name == best_hotel_name][0]

# Step 6: Get the address of the selected hotel
hotel_address = get_hotels_address(best_hotel_name).get("address")

# Step 7: Print the result
print("Hotel suggestion for Paris (May 1st to May 5th):")
print("Name:", best_hotel_name)
print("Rating:", best_hotel_rating)
print("Price per night:", best_hotel_price)

# Step 8: Add calendar event on April 25th, 2024
create_calendar_event(
    title=f"Booking hotel {best_hotel_name}",
    start_time="2024-04-25 09:00",
    end_time="2024-04-25 09:30",
    description=f"Reminder to book {best_hotel_name} in Paris. Address: {hotel_address}",
    participants=None,
    location=hotel_address
)
```
